title: Stock Up on the Best Prime Day Deals on Phone Accessories
gist: Wired's Prime Day phone-accessory deals page notes electronics prices have risen across the board and that deals are weaker than in the past; recommends Anker, Belkin, and Qi2 chargers, power banks and cases.

insights.claim: Wired's research found that electronics prices have gone up across the board and Prime Day deals are not as good as in the past.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Discount depth is shrinking, consistent with cost inflation in electronics hardware.
insights.locator: prices on electronics have gone up across the board

insights.claim: The author says the best Android phones and iPhones can last up to seven years, so spend should shift from annual upgrades to accessories.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Longer upgrade cycles shift value toward accessory and ecosystem vendors.
insights.locator: little reason to upgrade every year

insights.claim: Anker's MagGo 3-in-1 Qi2 chargers (UFO at $60, station at $76) and Belkin's 3-in-1 Qi2 stand at $63 hit record lows, showing Qi2/MagSafe accessories are a promotional focus.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Qi2 adoption makes magnetic charging a mainstream accessory category with price competition.

insights.claim: Belkin's UltraCharge 2-in-1 foldable Qi2 25W charger at $43 is the cheapest seen anywhere, highlighting 25W Qi2 as the faster wireless tier.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Faster Qi2 wattage is entering the budget segment.

insights.claim: Anker's 25,000 mAh, 165W laptop power bank was $96, and Anker is the most represented brand across Wired's picks in power banks, chargers and cables.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Anker has outsized shelf share in the mobile-power category.

insights.claim: Wired recommends Chipolo trackers over Tile or AirTag because they work with both Apple and Google devices, discounted 14-15%.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Cross-platform tracker compatibility is a differentiator versus Apple's AirTag.

insights.claim: Bandolier's crossbody phone case, compatible with iPhone 16 through the new iPhone 18, is Wired's top crossbody case at $134.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Confirms the current iPhone generation as the iPhone 18.
